Method of Attack: Encrypts victim's data files using Salsa20 algorithm with unique keys per file
Encrypts each file's key using RSA-512 and stores it in the last 252 bytes of the file
Removes all shadow volume copies to prevent data restoration
Creates ransom notes in encrypted folders and Startup folder
Uses email attachments for spreading infection
Uses Tor payment site requiring upload of encrypted file to login
Allows decryption of one test file to prove decryption capability
Impacted Systems: Windows computers (implied by references to shadow volume copies and Start Menu paths)
Indicators of Compromise: Ransom notes named README_HOW_TO_UNLOCK.HTML and README_HOW_TO_UNLOCK.TXT in encrypted folders and Startup folder
Tor payment site called Unlock Service
Bitcoin ransom demand of 0.24 bitcoins (~$100 USD)
Use of Salsa20 encryption and RSA-512 for key encryption
